policy.primary: Use Lucide for everyday controls, navigation, and actions.
policy.secondary: Use Material Symbols Rounded when the required object or concept is not available in Lucide.
policy.brands: Keep company and product marks in a separate verified brand collection.
policy.custom: Draw a new icon only when neither approved family communicates the concept and the mark is not a brand asset.

families.name: Lucide
families.purpose: Clear interface actions and navigation with one consistent outline language.

families.purpose: A broad vocabulary for objects, domains, devices, places, and specialist concepts.
